speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a child presenting with frequent nosebleeds, bleeding gums or other mucous membranes, and a rash of tiny red spots called petechiae. To understand what is happening with your blood, have you been told that you bruise very easily, and do you have any family members who bleed easily or have "big blue bubbles" in their skin?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
